result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears largely well-structured. One notable issue is a loading spinner overlaying the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, suggesting incomplete content load.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card image shows a loading spinner in the center, indicating the image has not finished loading or is stuck.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads properly; add a timeout fallback or placeholder image if loading fails, and verify network/asset loading logic.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are inconsistent between cards; the Tokumaru card has an outlined white heart while the pizza card below has a dark filled circular heart, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon style and background treatment across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
